space.name: Space
space.blurb: Past the sky: the moon, the old star station and the green planet beyond it.
space.travel: The engines roar, the blue goes black, and the Valley shrinks to a green coin below.
space.leave: Down through the clouds, and the Valley smells of grass again.

areas.name: The Moon
areas.blurb: Grey dust, low gravity, a crystal spire.

areas.name: Star Station
areas.blurb: An empty station humming in orbit.

areas.name: Green Planet
areas.blurb: Teal moss and glowing mushrooms.

colonies.name: Merkitty Colonies
colonies.blurb: Four island colonies, each kept alive by a star crystal. Pip's ferry sails from the beach pier.
colonies.travel: Pip's ferry rocks out past the breakers. Salt spray, gulls, and the Valley falls behind the waves.
colonies.leave: The ferry bumps the pier. Home sand under your boots.

areas.name: Coral Reach
areas.blurb: Warm shallows and coral huts.

areas.name: Kelp Hollow
areas.blurb: A village in the kelp forest.

areas.name: Frostfin Isle
areas.blurb: Snow, ice floes, frostfin cats.

areas.name: Emberclaw Atoll
areas.blurb: Black sand and a smoking peak.

cities.name: Lieutenant Cities
cities.blurb: The President's city: every district run by one of his lieutenants.
cities.travel: The night bus hisses into the city. Neon on wet glass, sirens far off, and the Valley is a rumour.
cities.travel_day: The city bus wheezes downtown. Billboards, horns, and the Valley is a rumour.
cities.leave: The last bus rattles out past the billboards. Crickets again.

areas.name: The Docks
areas.blurb: Harbourmaster Vance's cranes and crates.

areas.name: Neon
areas.blurb: Lucia's rain-soaked strip.

areas.name: Uptown
areas.blurb: Silas Crane's marble and the tower.

areas.name: The Pit
areas.blurb: Brock's fight club under the streets.

areas.name: Junction City
areas.blurb: Rail town; every train CANCELLED.
areas.travel: The night train hauls out of town, coal smoke and sparks, and rolls into Junction City.
areas.leave: The night train brakes beside the ticket booth. Town lamps, quiet streets, crickets again.

areas.name: Freight Yards
areas.blurb: Rail bots and rusting freight.
areas.travel: The night train hauls out of town, coal smoke and sparks, and rolls into Junction City.
areas.leave: The night train brakes beside the ticket booth. Town lamps, quiet streets, crickets again.

areas.name: Mill District
areas.blurb: Brick mills and the Baron's silo.
areas.travel: The night train hauls out of town, coal smoke and sparks, and rolls into Junction City.
areas.leave: The night train brakes beside the ticket booth. Town lamps, quiet streets, crickets again.

areas.name: Coalbrook Tunnels
areas.blurb: Old rail tunnels and the Baron's car.
areas.travel: The night train hauls out of town, coal smoke and sparks, and rolls into Junction City.
areas.leave: The night train brakes beside the ticket booth. Town lamps, quiet streets, crickets again.

hollow.name: The Hollow Heart
hollow.blurb: Under the deepest mine floor, a whole country lit by crystal.
hollow.travel: The long lift sinks for minutes. The air turns warm, and crystal light comes up to meet you.
hollow.leave: The lift climbs and climbs, and at last there is daylight in the shaft.

areas.name: Hollow Heart
areas.blurb: Crystal caverns and the heart below.

areas.name: The Glowing Deeps
areas.blurb: Crystal rivers east of the Heart, where the old miners camped.

sky.name: Sky Isles
sky.blurb: Islands floating on cloud above the great tree. Something enormous swims beneath them.
sky.travel: Up the stair inside the great tree, until there is no tree: only cloud underfoot and sky all round.
sky.leave: Down the great tree's stair, ring after ring, back to the forest floor.

areas.name: Cloud Isles
areas.blurb: Floating islands and the knight's stair.

areas.name: Whale Reaches
areas.blurb: High cloud where the sky whale circles.

gloamwood.name: Gloamwood
gloamwood.blurb: A forest of lanterns and violet moss, past a fairy ring in the woods.
gloamwood.travel: The ring hums, the forest folds up like paper, and lanterns bloom around you.
gloamwood.leave: The ring lets go, and it's plain old daylight in the forest again.

areas.name: Lanternfall
areas.blurb: Lanterns on mushrooms, and a pond that glows.

areas.name: Violet Glade
areas.blurb: Teal moss, wisps and sleepy moths.

areas.name: Crystal Thicket
areas.blurb: Crystal trees that ring in the wind.

areas.name: The Moonpool
areas.blurb: Black water, and the Thornmother beneath.

sunscorch.name: Sunscorch Expanse
sunscorch.blurb: Past the dunes: an oasis post, a glass canyon and a temple with a giant at the door.
sunscorch.travel: The caravan's sails fill. Three days of gold dunes, then palms and a well: Mirage Post.
sunscorch.leave: The caravan beaches on your own coast, sand in everything.

areas.name: Mirage Post
areas.blurb: The last well before the Expanse.

areas.name: The Dune Sea
areas.blurb: Dunes, a buried bus, and singing sand.

areas.name: Glass Canyon
areas.blurb: Red rock and lightning glass.

areas.name: Sunken Temple
areas.blurb: The Sun Colossus guards the door.

frostpeak.name: Frostpeak Reach
frostpeak.blurb: Above the mountain: a snow village, glaciers, ice caves and the Summit.
frostpeak.travel: The sled climbs past the clouds into white. Smoke from chimneys: Hearthhold.
frostpeak.leave: The sled shoots down out of the snow, and the valley is green and warm.

areas.name: Hearthhold
areas.blurb: Snow-domed houses and a hot spring.

areas.name: Glacier Fields
areas.blurb: White fields, frost wolves, rime golems.

areas.name: Rime Caverns
areas.blurb: Blue ice caves that hum.

areas.name: Frozen Falls
areas.blurb: A waterfall frozen mid-pour; pike below.

areas.name: The Summit
areas.blurb: Where the Rime Wyrm sleeps.

windward.name: Windward Isles
windward.blurb: Islands above the sky islands, where the Storm Roc nests.
windward.travel: The balloon lifts through the last cloud into blue, and islands float by like stepping stones.
windward.leave: The balloon bumps down in the east meadow. Grass, at last.

areas.name: Breezehaven
areas.blurb: Windmill isles and a penguin captain.

areas.name: Sunrise Shelf
areas.blurb: Always just sunrise.

areas.name: Storm Shelf
areas.blurb: Lightning in black cloud.

areas.name: Starfall Garden
areas.blurb: Stars close enough to touch; the Roc's nest.

giltcity.name: Gilt City
giltcity.blurb: Madame Aurum's city of casinos, gardens and vaults.
giltcity.travel: The limousine purrs through the dark and out into gold stone, statues, and a hundred lit windows.
giltcity.leave: The limo drops you at the farm gate and glides away without a sound.

areas.name: Grand Plaza
areas.blurb: Gold stone, statues, a hundred windows.

areas.name: Casino Row
areas.blurb: Neon on gold.

areas.name: Gilded Gardens
areas.blurb: Hedges clipped into crowns.

areas.name: The Vaults
areas.blurb: Madame Aurum's gold, stacked to the ceiling.
